summary: Affirm Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose Amendment No. 4 to its Revolving Credit Agreement with Barclays Bank PLC as administrative agent. The amendment increases aggregate commitments from $330M to $675M, extends maturity to June 18, 2029 (with a conditional earlier maturity linked to outstanding 2026 convertible notes), and modifies interest rates (SOFR +1.50% or base rate +0.50%) and commitment fees (0.15%). Borrowings are unsecured and guaranteed by the company and domestic subsidiaries. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
